description: Fork of exp567 (E=96, 1.4768 @ 103.02M / 475 Mbits/token). ONLY change: out_proj single TinyMHLut(NAP=6, tph=1024, n_out=96) -> TinyMultiNapMultiHeadLut summed over [(NAP=4, tph=128), (NAP=6, tph=64), (NAP=8, tph=96)] (exp387 recipe ported to E=96 backbone). Strictly cheaper on BOTH axes: params 103.02M -> ~82.96M (-20M), per-token bandwidth 475 -> ~461 Mbits (-13.6 Mbits via out_proj 18.9 -> 5.3 Mbits). Tests whether the row-collapse mitigation that won on tiny LUT-LM (exp387 = -0.012 vs baseline) transfers to mid-scale at E=96. Adjudication vs exp567 1.4768: any win = Pareto-better than exp567 (both axes); broaden to v/residual multi-NAP in exp570. Flat = mechanism needs shape calibration at bigger E. Regression = row-collapse not present at this scale. Refs: exp387 multi-NAP win 1.6097, exp390 NAP=4-only 1.6009, vanilla-untied exp476 1.4143 / 742 Mbits (loss+bandwidth target).
